# ProcessDashboard

The overview dashboard (`GET /processes/summary`).

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `windowStart` | `datetime` | UTC start of the first hour bucket. The window runs from here to now. |
| `hours` | `integer` | The number of hour buckets in the window. |
| `byType` | [`ProcessTypeStateCounts`](process-type-state-counts.md)`[]` | Run counts by state, one row per kind of run. |
| `activeRuns` | [`ProcessSummary`](process-summary.md)`[]` | Live runs (state Active or Waiting), newest first, at most 20. |
| `recentFailures` | [`ProcessSummary`](process-summary.md)`[]` | Runs created in the window that ended in Error, newest first, at most 10. |
| `throughput` | [`ProcessThroughputPoint`](process-throughput-point.md)`[]` | One point per hour per process type, zero-filled. |
| `tokens` | [`ProcessTokenPoint`](process-token-point.md)`[]` | One point per hour, zero-filled. |
